title: Myvi sarat PATI termasuk bayi terbabas ketika lari dari polis
summary: TUMPAT: Lapan pendatang asing tanpa izin (PATI) termasuk seorang bayi perempuan berusia sembilan bulan ditemukan bersesak dalam sebuah kereta ketika cuba menyeludup masuk ke negara ini, semalam.

title_en: Myvi loaded with PATI including baby crashes while fleeing from police
summary_en: TUMPAT: Eight illegal foreign immigrants (PATI) including a nine-month-old baby girl were found crammed in a car while trying to smuggle into the country yesterday.
